item.title: What is the difference between phone mute and silent modes?
item.description: Many smartphone users confuse mute and silent modes, but they control completely different audio functions. Mute mode silences your microphone during calls so others can't hear you, while silent mode stops your phone from making notification sounds and ringtones. Understanding this distinction helps you manage interruptions effectively—whether you're in a conference call from a noisy location or sitting in a cinema where incoming alerts would disturb others.
